description: This file defines a singleton object StringUtils providing utility methods to join a LinkedList into a String and split a String into a LinkedList, delegating the actual implementation to JoinUtils and SplitUtils.

classes.name: StringUtils
classes.description: A singleton object with utility functions to manipulate strings and LinkedLists.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Converts a LinkedList into a String by delegating to JoinUtils.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a String into a LinkedList by delegating to SplitUtils.
